question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Dream
solution:
The correct answer is **"Reality."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dream** means a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. (सपना, स्‍वप्‍न)

 
 
• **Example**: *I had a bad **dream**__.*
 
 
 
• **Reality** means the state of things as they actually exist, as opposed to an idealistic or notional idea of them. (वास्‍तविकता, यथार्थ (जीवन जैसा है वैसा, न कि जैसा वह लग सकता है या जैसा हमें पसंद है))
 __
 
• **Example**: *I enjoyed my holiday, but now it’s back to **reality**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"Dream"** is **"Reality."**
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delusion** means an idiosyncratic belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by what is generally accepted as reality or rational argument. (भ्रम, भ्रांति)
 
• **Fancy **means the faculty of imagination or the ability to form mental images or concepts of things that are not present to the senses. (जो सीधा-सादा या साधारण न हो; विशिष्‍ट)
 
• **Imagination** means the faculty or action of forming new ideas, or images or concepts of external objects not present to the senses. (नए विचारों, या बाहरी वस्तुओं की छवियां या अवधारणाएं बनाने की क्षमता या क्रिया जो इंद्रियों के सामने मौजूद नहीं हैं)
